newsitem.title: UK: IBCA affirms Banca Popolare Verona ratings.
newsitem.headline: IBCA affirms Banca Popolare Verona ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Tuesday it affirmed Banca Popolare di Verona S Geminiano e S Prospero's (BPVGP) A plus long-term and A1 short-term ratings.
"The bank's individual rating is affirmed at A/B and its legal rating of 4 is also unchanged," IBCA said in a statement.
"Following the merger at the end of last year between Banca Popolare di Verona and S Geminiano e S Prospero, BPVGP's performance has remained strong," IBCA said.
It said the two banks' networks were complementary and had given the new entity a deep-rooted coverage of their respective market.
"BPVGP's asset quality indicators have also remained good, partly thanks to a wealthy area of operations and partly thanks to stringent credit assessment procedures and controls," IBCA said.
The rating agency said BPVGP was well capitalised, with an end-1995 EU total capital ratio of 10.50 percent of which 8.17 percent was tier 1.
"The bank's total capital ratio was rasied to over 11 percent in January 1996 following a further subordinated debt issue of 250 billion lire," IBCA said.
